title: WPMS/2293/2015 of Smt. Kamla Joshi Vs Assistant Collector 1st Class AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No. 2293 of 2015
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Mr. Lok Pal Singh, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. Navneet Kaushik, Advocate for the
respondent/applicant.
MCC No. 662 of 2015
Mr. Navneet Kaushik, learned counsel
for the recall applicant submits that defendant /
recall applicant was away in service; petitioner
/plaintiff has filed Revenue Suit No. 27/156 of
2000-2001, Smt. Kamla Joshi Vs. Govind
Ballabh and others, under Section 176 of U.P.
Z.A. & L.R. Act for partition of holding; no
service was effected on the defendant / recall
applicant, herein; plaintiff / petitioner has
produced the imposter before the Trial Court
and imposter claiming himself as defendant /
recall applicant has filed written statement;
with the help of imposter, by playing fraud on
the Court, plaintiff / petitioner was able to get
his suit decreed; when defendant / recall
applicant came back from service and started
his construction, plaintiff / petitioner has
stopped defendant / recall applicant in raising
construction saying property, in question, has
fallen in the share of the plaintiff / petitioner;
whereupon an inquiry was held and it was
found that imposter was produced before the
Court on behalf of the defendant / recall
applicant and suit was got decreed; defendant /
recall applicant has lodged the F.I.R.; F.I.R.
was challenged before this Court, however, in
vain; thereafter, judgment and decree was set
aside and, now, plaintiff / petitioner has sought
permission to withdraw the suit.

As to whether plaintiff petitioner with
the collusion of imposter has played fraud on
the Court or the imposter has filed written
statement claiming himself to be defendant /
recall applicant, is a matter of investigation
and the question as to whether any fraud was
played on the Court or imposter was produced
before the Court, can be inquire into by the
Court under Section 340 Cr.P.C. as well.
Mr. Navneet Kaushik, learned counsel
for the defendant / recall applicant submits that
application under Section 340 Cr.P.C. shall
also be moved before the Court.
Since, plaintiff is entitled to withdraw
his suit, therefore, I do not find any reason to
recall the observation made in the order sought
to be recalled. However, recall application is
disposed of with the direction / clarification
that withdrawal of the suit and order under
recall dated 14.09.2015 shall not affect the
investigation being carried on by the Police on
the F.I.R. filed by the defendant / recall
applicant or any inquiry contemplated by the
Court under Section 340 Cr.P.C.
It goes without saying, if plaintiff /
petitioner, herein, is found guilty for playing
fraud by producing imposter on behalf of the
defendant / recall applicant,
plaintiff/petitioner, herein, has to face music
thereof in accordance with law.
 (Alok Singh, J.)
Dated 30.09.2015
Shiv
